task_instance: Implement the fictional `examplecloud` Terraform provider's credential provider chain in Go, following the skill's documented pattern: a Provider interface with Retrieve()/Name(), a sentinel ErrNoCredentials, StaticProvider/EnvProvider/FileProvider sources, a Chain that walks them in order (static > env > shared credentials file) and resolves secrets as a complete set (not field-by-field), a ChainError that aggregates per-source failure reasons and whose Is() distinguishes clean fall-through from a hard failure, a Credentials type with redacting String()/GoString(), a FilePermissionWarning helper for group/world-readable credentials files, and a NewDefaultChain constructor -- then wrote and ran Go unit tests covering per-source behavior, precedence, failure aggregation, hard-error vs fall-through distinction, and secret redaction, per the skill's 'Unit Testing the Chain' checklist.
evidence: Work done in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/hashicorp__agent-skills__provider-configuration@offline-workstation. Files: go.mod (module examplecloud, go1.24), credentials/chain.go (full implementation: ErrNoCredentials, Credentials with redacting String()/GoString(), Provider interface, StaticProvider, EnvProvider (injectable Getenv), FileProvider (minimal INI shared-credentials-file parser, distinguishes a defaulted vs explicitly-requested missing profile), ChainError with Is(ErrNoCredentials) semantics, Chain, NewDefaultChain, FilePermissionWarning), credentials/chain_test.go (13 subtests / 8 top-level tests). Ran with GOPROXY=off (no network) using only the Go standard library (bufio, os, path/filepath, strings, errors, fmt, context) -- no external modules needed. `go build ./...` succeeded with no output, `go vet ./...` reported nothing, and `go test ./... -v` produced 'PASS / ok examplecloud/credentials 0.008s' with every subtest listed as PASS, including: per-source completeness/fall-through for static, env, and file providers; profile resolution (default, named, missing-but-defaulted falls through, missing-but-explicitly-requested is a hard error, malformed file is a hard error); chain precedence (static beats env beats file, and an incomplete env key does NOT merge with a file secret -- the chain falls through to the file as a full set); errors.Is(err, ErrNoCredentials) is true only when every source fell through cleanly, and false when one source is genuinely malformed while its error text is preserved; fmt.Sprintf with %v/%+v/%#v and explicit String()/GoString() calls never contain the secret value; and an end-to-end NewDefaultChain resolution from a temp-dir credentials file. This is a pure-Go, standard-library-only task (references/credential-chain.md and references/case-studies.md mentioned by SKILL.md are not present next to SKILL.md in this checkout, but SKILL.md itself documents the interfaces, error semantics, precedence rules, and required test cases in enough detail to implement and verify the deliverable directly, without needing those reference files or any Terraform SDK/network dependency).
